## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Scope and contract

Which packages/examples change? Explain any token, class, content-contract, dependency, or licensing changes. State known limitations and follow-up work.

## Verification

Record commands actually run and their outcomes. Explain any skipped check.

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Relevant relative links, assets, and package exports work.
- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, private-site content, or unlicensed assets.

For visual changes, attach fictional-content screenshots and record checks at 390, 768, 1280, and 1440 pixels, including keyboard/focus, reduced motion, long titles, optional images, and overflow. Automated accessibility results supplement manual inspection.

## Publication state

State whether any publishing or deployment occurred. This PR does not authorize a merge, npm publication, GitHub release, Pages enablement, or production deployment.
